name: Google Docs
description: Read, create, and edit Google Docs with professional formatting and branding. Edits are surgical and in-place by default (find/replace, delete-section, insert-at-anchor) so all untouched formatting is preserved. Rich styling via docs-style (font, size, color, spacing, shading). Create beautifully formatted docs from HTML with full branding support. A docx round-trip is reserved for wholesale rebuilds. Includes a formatting fingerprint for before/after verification, plus review comments.
summary: Work with Google Docs — create professionally formatted documents with branding, surgically edit in place (formatting preserved), apply rich styling (fonts, colors, spacing, shading), rebuild via docx only when needed, verify with a formatting fingerprint, and leave review comments.
author: architect-prime
when_to_use: When a task involves reading, creating, editing, or finalizing a Google Doc, or leaving review comments on one.
